import yfinance as yf
from datetime import datetime

# input is the item from the previous node
ticker_symbol = _input.item.json.get("nse_code") 

# Handle ".NS" suffix for NSE if missing
if not ticker_symbol.endswith(".NS") and not ticker_symbol.endswith(".BO"):
    ticker_symbol += ".NS"

stock = yf.Ticker(ticker_symbol)
info = stock.info

# Helper function to safely get data or return None
def get_val(key):
    return info.get(key, None)

# Calculate Returns
current = get_val('currentPrice') or 0
high_52 = get_val('fiftyTwoWeekHigh') or 1
low_52 = get_val('fiftyTwoWeekLow') or 1

# Logic for "Down from High" and "Up from Low"
down_from_high = ((current - high_52) / high_52) * 100 if high_52 else 0
up_from_low = ((current - low_52) / low_52) * 100 if low_52 else 0

# Construct Chart URLs dynamically
base_chart = f"https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/{ticker_symbol}/chart"

return {
    "json": {
        "nse_code": _input.item.json.get("nse_code"),
        "company_name": get_val('longName'),
        "sector": get_val('sector'),
        "industry": get_val('industry'),
        
        # Prices
        "current_price": current,
        "high_52_week high": high_52,
        "low_52_week": low_52,
        "volume": get_val('volume'),
        "return_down_from_52w_high": round(down_from_high, 2),
        "return_up_from_52w_low": round(up_from_low, 2),

        # Valuation
        "market_cap": get_val('marketCap'),
        "pe_ttm": get_val('trailingPE'),
        "eps_ttm": get_val('trailingEps'),
        "book_value": get_val('bookValue'),
        "dividend_yield": (get_val('dividendYield') or 0) * 100,

        # Financials
        "revenue_ttm": get_val('totalRevenue'),
        "ebitda_ttm": get_val('ebitda'),
        "debt": get_val('totalDebt'),
        "cash_equivalents": get_val('totalCash'),
        "roe": get_val('returnOnEquity'),
        
        # Analyst Targets
        "consensus_target_price": get_val('targetMeanPrice'),
        "target_price_high": get_val('targetHighPrice'),
        "target_price_low": get_val('targetLowPrice'),

        # Construct URLs
        "chart_url_1m": f"{base_chart}?range=1mo",
        "chart_url_3m": f"{base_chart}?range=3mo",
        "chart_url_6m": f"{base_chart}?range=6mo",
        "chart_url_12m": f"{base_chart}?range=1y",
        
        "updated_at": datetime.now().isoformat()
    }
}
